mn3:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn3:2.1: Dhammadāyādā me bhikkhave bhavatha mā āmisadāyādā;
mn3:2.3: kinti me sāvakā dhammadāyādā bhaveyyuṃ no āmisadāyādā ti.
mn3:2.4: Tumhe ca me bhikkhave āmisadāyādā bhaveyyātha no dhammadāyādā, tumhe pi tena ādissā bhaveyyātha:
mn3:2.5: āmisadāyādā Satthu sāvakā viharanti no dhammadāyādā ti,
mn3:2.7: āmisadāyādā Satthu sāvakā viharanti no dhammadāyādā ti.
mn3:2.8: Tumhe ca me bhikkhave dhammadāyādā bhaveyyātha no āmisadāyādā, tumhe pi tena na ādissā bhaveyyātha:

mn3:3.1: Idhāhaṃ bhikkhave bhuttāvī assaṃ pavārito paripuṇṇo pariyosito suhito yāvadattho,
mn3:3.2: siyā ca me piṇḍapāto atirekadhammo chaḍḍiyadhammo,
mn3:3.3: atha dve bhikkhū āgaccheyyuṃ jighacchādubbalyaparetā. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn3:3.5: Ahaṃ kho 'mhi bhikkhave bhuttāvī pavārito paripuṇṇo pariyosito suhito yāvadattho,
mn3:3.6: atthi ca me ayaṃ piṇḍapāto atirekadhammo chaḍḍiyadhammo,
mn3:3.7: sace ākaṅkhatha bhuñjatha, sace tumhe na bhuñjissatha idānāhaṃ appaharite vā chaḍḍessāmi appāṇake vā udake opilāpessāmīti.
mn3:3.9: Bhagavā kho bhuttāvī pavārito paripuṇṇo pariyosito suhito yāvadattho,
mn3:3.10: atthi cāyaṃ Bhagavato piṇḍapāto atirekadhammo chaḍḍiyadhammo,
mn3:3.11: sace mayaṃ na bhuñjissāma idāni Bhagavā appaharite vā chaḍḍessati appāṇake vā udake opilāpessati;
mn3:3.13: Dhammadāyādā me bhikkhave bhavatha mā āmisadāyādā ti;
mn3:3.14: āmisaññataraṃ kho pan' etaṃ yadidaṃ piṇḍapāto,
mn3:3.15: yan-nūnāhaṃ imaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ abhuñjitvā iminā jighacchādubballena evaṃ imaṃ rattindivaṃ vītināmeyyan-ti.
mn3:3.16: So taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ abhuñjitvā ten' eva jighacchādubballena evaṃ taṃ rattindivaṃ vītināmeyya.
mn3:3.18: Bhagavā kho bhuttāvī pavārito paripuṇṇo pariyosito suhito yāvadattho,
mn3:3.19: atthi cāyaṃ Bhagavato piṇḍapāto atirekadhammo chaḍḍiyadhammo,
mn3:3.20: sace mayaṃ na bhuñjissāma idāni Bhagavā appaharite vā chaḍḍessati appāṇake vā udake opilāpessati,
mn3:3.21: yan-nūnāhaṃ imaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā jighacchādubballaṃ paṭivinetvā evaṃ imaṃ rattindivaṃ vītināmeyyan-ti.
mn3:3.22: So taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā jighacchādubballaṃ paṭivinetvā evaṃ taṃ rattindivaṃ vītināmeyya.
mn3:3.23: Kiñcāpi so bhikkhave bhikkhu taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā jighacchādubballaṃ paṭivinetvā evaṃ taṃ rattindivaṃ vītināmeyya, atha kho asu yeva me purimo bhikkhu pujjataro ca pāsaṃsataro ca;
mn3:3.25: taṃ hi tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno dīgharattaṃ appicchatāya santuṭṭhiyā sallekhāya subharatāya viriyārambhāya saṃvattissati.
mn3:3.26: Tasmātiha me bhikkhave dhammadāyādā bhavatha mā āmisadāyādā;
mn3:3.28: kinti me sāvakā dhammadāyādā bhaveyyuṃ no āmisadāyādā ti.
mn3:4.2: idaṃ vatvā Sugato uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
mn3:4.3: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto acirapakkantassa Bhagavato bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn3:4.5: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn3:5.1: Kittāvatā nu kho āvuso Satthu pavivittassa viharato sāvakā vivekaṃ nānusikkhanti, kittāvatā ca pana Satthu pavivittassa viharato sāvakā vivekam-anusikkhantīti. --
mn3:5.2: Dūrato pi kho mayaṃ āvuso āgaccheyyāma āyasmato Sāriputtassa santike etassa bhāsitassa atthamaññātuṃ,
mn3:5.3: sādhu vat' āyasmantaṃ yeva Sāriputtaṃ paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho,
mn3:5.5: Tena h' āvuso suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmīti.
mn3:5.6: Evam-āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
mn3:6.1: Idh' āvuso Satthu pavivittassa viharato sāvakā vivekaṃ nānusikkhanti,
mn3:6.3: yesañ-ca dhammānaṃ Satthā pahānam-āha te ca dhamme na-ppajahanti,
mn3:6.4: bāhulikā ca honti sāthalikā, okkamane pubbaṅgamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā.
mn3:6.5: Tatr' āvuso therā bhikkhū tīhi ṭhānehi gārayhā bhavanti:
mn3:6.6: Satthu pavivittassa viharato sāvakā vivekaṃ nānusikkhantīti,
mn3:6.7: iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena therā bhikkhū gārayhā bhavanti.
mn3:6.8: Yesañ-ca dhammānaṃ Satthā pahānam-āha te ca dhamme na-ppajahantīti,
mn3:6.9: iminā dutiyena ṭhānena therā bhikkhū gārayhā bhavanti.
mn3:6.10: Bāhulikā ca sāthalikā, okkamane pubbaṅgamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā ti,
mn3:6.11: iminā tatiyena ṭhānena therā bhikkhū gārayhā bhavanti.
mn3:6.12: Therā h' āvuso bhikkhū imehi tīhi ṭhānehi gārayhā bhavanti.
mn3:6.14: navā bhikkhū tīhi ṭhānehi gārayhā bhavanti:

mn3:6.16: iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena navā bhikkhū gārayhā bhavanti.

mn3:6.19: Bāhulikā ca sāthalikā, okkamane pubbaṅgamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā ti,
